_meta.theme: recovery ledger — af cost must not count recovered work as WASTED
_meta.design: T1 puts the attempt number in the archive name (parser disambiguates by ts >= 1_000_000_000). T2 writes a 'recovered' receipt (non-verdict, wall_clock_s 0) when af recover or auto-reuse merges an archived branch, and af cost shows a RECOVERED: line that pairs the recovered failed receipt out of WASTED. T3 adds --attempt N to af recover to select a specific archive.
